versions.changelog:
- Added a contrast-checking script: scripts/check-contrast.mjs.
- Enables automated validation of color contrast ratios for design tokens and palettes.
- Script can be run via Node to ensure color pairs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards.
- Supports both single pair and JSON-configured palette checks for seamless integration into build/CI pipelines.

Initial release of the web-accessibility skill:

- Provides WCAG 2.2 Level AA guidance for design systems, UI components, and web pages.
- Includes a runnable Node-based contrast validator and patterns for accessible color tokens.
- Gives practical checklists for typography, interactive states, and semantic markup.
- Offers step-by-step instructions for integrating accessibility into development and build processes.
- Clarifies the boundaries of automated checks vs. manual testing for full conformance.
